svg.font-family: SF Pro Text, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Film Format is set by the pair.
Sections marked with the link change both halves:
one roll is one stock, one print, one development.
The rest belongs to the half picked above, or on the
canvas: exposure, white balance, placement, crop,
3 · The pair open: one canvas, one half picked
One half is always picked (the open-frame mark); hovering the other shows a dashed mark. Click it, or ⇥, to switch.
Gap: the film between frames, black by default, 1 mm of 37 (D6). Layout, order and gap live in “Half-Frame Pair”.
Linked sections (chain) write both halves. Film Format reads “Set by Pair”: 135 half, 24 mm, so grain is half-frame grain.
Left / Right in the panel header: the same pick as the canvas, with the file name, so it is never ambiguous.
“this half” sections edit only the picked half. A short note at the foot says which is which.
In the filmstrip a pair is one cell: two halves and their gap. Its frames are not listed again (D1).
